label: Handyman
description: Small repairs: doors, cabinets, shelves, drywall holes, mounting and assembly.

required_shots.prompt: Get close to what needs fixing
required_shots.tip: Show the damage or the part that's loose.
required_shots.hint: A clear close-up of the item or damage to repair.

required_shots.prompt: Step back and show it in the room
required_shots.tip: So the pro can judge size and access.
required_shots.hint: A wider view showing the item, its size and what's around it.

required_shots.prompt: Show any parts or materials you have
required_shots.tip: Hardware, a new shelf, paint, the box it came in.
required_shots.hint: Parts, hardware or materials the homeowner already has.

questions.q: What kind of job is it?

severity_guide: a quick cosmetic fix: a loose handle, a squeaky hinge
one small repair or install: a shelf, a door that sticks, a small hole
a few related tasks or a larger single repair
a large repair, several rooms, or damage that's getting worse
damage that makes something unsafe or unusable, e.g. a door that won't close or a falling fixture

policy.finding_wording: Repair needed as shown, on-site visit recommended.
rules: Describe what is visible; don't guess hidden damage.
affected_area_m2 is the damaged or worked-on surface, often under 1.
